commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Alejandro Frances (Girona) is shown a red card by the referee after criticising his decision!
90+6' The foul by Arnau Martinez (Girona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Isidro Diaz.
90+4' Valencia get a corner.
90+2' Alex Moreno (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90+1' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Hugo Rincon (Girona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
89' Isidro Diaz blows for a foul after Javi Guerra (Valencia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
86' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
83' Michel prepares a substitution. Portu is replaced by Bryan Gil (Girona).
83' Portu (Girona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
83' That's the end of the game for Yaser Asprilla, who is replaced by Lass Kourouma (Girona).
83' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Dani Raba (Valencia) replaces Diego Lopez.
82' The attendance for today's match is 10867.
80' Ivan Martin (Girona) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
78' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' Neat passing move from Valencia in order to create new attacking opportunities.
75' The referee blows for a cooling break.
74' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Duro (Valencia) comes onto the pitch for Lucas Beltran.
72' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Thierry Correia and he is replaced by Largie Ramazani (Valencia).
72' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
71' Alex Moreno (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
68' Substitution. Vladyslav Vanat leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
68' Isidro Diaz sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
64' Girona score a goal, but referee Isidro Diaz has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
63' 2 - 1 Goal! Arnau Martinez (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:1.
62' The referee points to the corner flag and Valencia will take a corner.
61' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.

61' Thierry Correia (Valencia) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.
60' The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.

60' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
57' 1 - 1 Goal! Arnaut Danjuma puts a cross into the box and finds Diego Lopez (Valencia), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
57' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Ivan Martin (Girona) for his blatant foul.
56' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) commits a rough foul. Isidro Diaz stops the game and makes a call.
55' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
54' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a throw-in.
53' Hugo Rincon (Girona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.
50' The Valencia players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
49' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
46' Carlos Corberan has made a change at the break. Javi Guerra (Valencia) has come on in place of Baptiste Santamaria.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+5' The ball is cleared after Yaser Asprilla (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+1' Vitor Reis (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

42' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. Unfortunately, he only found the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
41' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
38' Girona spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
35' The Girona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' Girona are ruled offside.
30' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Valencia.
28' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
27' Girona are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
23' Michel is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alejandro Frances suffers an injury and Hugo Rincon (Girona) comes on.
21' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) and Jose Copete matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.

18' 1 - 0 Goal! Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Julen Agirrezabala had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
17' Girona are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
16' Alejandro Frances (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
16' Alejandro Frances (Girona) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
15' Valencia are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
13' Valencia keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
12' The ratio of the ball possession is 64:36.
11' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
9' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) is substituted due to injury. Carlos Corberan gives a chance to Jose Copete.
3' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
